mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% (a historical low for the cycle) indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 1.0% monthly, it indicates robust supply chain activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 1.0% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% annualized indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a dual economic shock that reduces corporate output and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment growth exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates a robust labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annualized indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates retail sales growth (RSAFS), boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized.
